meta.title: SAID IN KOREAN · Learn Korean online
meta.description: Learn Korean online with General Korean A1–C2 and TOPIK preparation courses, an optional level quiz, coaching and Speaking Chat.

home.title: Learn Korean, step by step
home.lede: Courses from your first Hangul letters to advanced Korean and TOPIK preparation. Begin with the alphabet, or take the optional level quiz to find your place.

paths.title: Find your way into Korean
paths.pending: A description will follow once the teacher has approved it.

free.title: Start with Hangul
free.name: Free alphabet course
free.body: Get to know the Korean alphabet, learn how its letters come together, and begin reading your first Korean words.
free.materials: Materials in English and German are in preparation.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.for: Complete beginners. If Hangul is new to you, start with the free alphabet course.
levels.about: By the end of the course, learners can introduce themselves and describe people, things and places with basic sentence patterns. They use the core particles, talk about past, present and future events, tell the time and dates, count with both number systems, and link sentences with “and”, “so” and “but”.

levels.name: Elementary
levels.for: Learners whose level quiz result suggests A2.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.for: Learners whose level quiz result suggests B1.

levels.name: Upper intermediate
levels.for: Learners whose level quiz result suggests B2.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.for: Learners whose level quiz result suggests C1.

levels.name: Proficient
levels.for: Learners whose level quiz result suggests C2.

topik.title: TOPIK preparation
topik.for: Learners preparing for the official TOPIK exam.
topik.note: Courses I–VI are our preparation pathway; their names are working titles. The official exam has two tests: TOPIK I (levels 1–2) and TOPIK II (levels 3–6).

quiz.title: Find your starting point
quiz.body: An optional quiz on reading, listening and writing across six levels. Your results suggest where you could begin.
